security_privacy_cost_impact: No secret, credential, tenant data, provider or database is touched. The classifier reads git objects only, with argument arrays (no shell), literal pathspecs and no network. The test builds a throwaway repository under the OS temp directory with a synthetic author that is not an e-mail address, and removes it. Cost: §6 (approved) replaces four role runs with one reading on records-only PRs and removes carry readings on mechanical syncs. No token or time figure is claimed.
migration_and_data_impact: None. No migration, policy, grant, probe or catalog change.
compatibility_impact: Tests on main ae163ed8: 724; this branch: 725 (one classifier test in foundation-contract): floor 86 -> 87, name digest and assertion floor (1329) in scripts/test-suite-contract.mjs; scripts/db/classify-records-only.mjs digested in test-kits/integrity-manifest.json and on DIGESTED_FLOOR (#204's E4 import-closure guard); 34 line pins in db/foundation/lint/audit-coverage-map.json raised by one; evidence/VERIFICATION.md written by npm run record:verification (725). No existing guard changes behaviour: §6 is process text, and the classifier is run by hand, not by CI.
known_limitations: The classifier decides the SHAPE of a diff by file name, not its content; §6.2 makes the reader check every quoted Owner word and role verdict against its source on main (A1-7 / C0 N1 closed in text). Only the reader enforces that.
A light-path reading names its head and is voided by a later commit other than the refresh (§6.2, R0 R2-1), but no script refuses such a commit.
A mechanical sync can still interact semantically with main (a validator the PR's records are judged by); §6.3 leaves that to CI on the final head.
CI does not run the classifier (RFC §6.6 item 1, owed to WP-0A-A0-004, A1-6).
